entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JIT: redundant struct-copy traffic and initialization #133832
  • [RISC-V] Eliminate redundant zero-extension after known zero-producing instructions #133829
  • JIT (bug): Loop cloning removes bounds checks from an unsigned countdown loop whose induction variable underflows #133824
    12.0.0
  • JIT (bug): Loop cloning drops bounds checks when an arr.Length + K loop limit overflows to a negative value #133823
    12.0.0
  • JIT (bug): GC deadlock — method stays partially interruptible after lowering unrolls the loop's only GC safepoint (Span.CopyTo) #133822
    12.0.0
  • JIT (bug): Signed compare against a path-dependent checked bound eliminates a bounds check #133821
    12.0.0
  • JIT (bug): Bounds check incorrectly eliminated — range analysis ignores signed underflow of `x + negativeConstant` #133820
    12.0.0
  • JIT (bug): Bounds check wrongly removed — decreasing recurrence treated as monotonically increasing #133818
    12.0.0
  • JIT (bug): `Enum.Equals` folding throws `NullReferenceException` instead of returning `false` for a `null` argument #133817
    12.0.0
  • System.Reflection.Context: types mapped by `CustomReflectionContext` throw `NotSupportedException` from `IsByRefLike` and three other `Type` members #133816
  • `Console.ReadLine()` returns each line one Enter late when `Console.TreatControlCAsInput` is `true` on Windows #133814
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner failed #133813
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: AsyncProfilerTests.StateMachineAsync_CallstackOverflow_PreservesFullDepth on osx-arm64 NativeAOT #133812
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: tracing/eventpipe/nonlossyblockenv drops events in non-lossy block mode #133811
  • [ci-scan] Build break: runtime-diagnostics MSBuild MSB1001 Unknown switch (--verbosity:m) #133810

Closed

  • Task/TaskAwaiter completion makes lots of duplicate memory reads #11806
    Future
  • [mono] Make mono aot-compiler a tool pack in the Sdk #89067
    Future
  • [wasm] move emsdk setup from runtime to emsdk tooling #105439
    Future
  • Switch Windows x86 GC to software write-watch and remove OS-backed write-watch #133799
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: coreclr interpreter assert INTERPRETER_CODE_POISON in SetInterpreterCode (method.hpp:1992) #133815
  • JIT: (bug) inlining an instance method that never uses `this` drops the receiver null check #133713
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) Loop cloning passes an out-of-region search start to fgFindInsertPoint when the loop's lexical bottom is in a nested try #133758
    12.0.0
